tables.3.7-5.0: include/monsters.h @ NetHack-5.0 (byte-identical to 3.7 apart from comments)

difficulty.3.6: 3.6 has no difficulty formula in the source at all: `makedefs -m` was deprecated (util/makedefs.c do_monstr() prints a deprecation notice and emits a stub file), so the mons[].difficulty column of src/monst.c is the only source.
difficulty.3.7-5.0: mstrength(), src/mondata.c:428. This generator re-implements it and checks the result against every row of the table.

uncommon.rule: G_NOGEN and G_UNIQ are never picked; inside Gehennom only monsters with maligntyp <= A_NEUTRAL may appear, outside it G_HELL monsters may not; G_NOHELL monsters are excluded inside Gehennom by rndmonst() itself

generation.weight: (geno & G_FREQ) + align_shift() [+ temperature_shift() in 3.7/5.0]; a monster whose weight comes out 0 is never picked

align_shift.rule: lawful level: (maligntyp + 20) / (2 * ALIGNWEIGHT); neutral level: (20 - |maligntyp|) / ALIGNWEIGHT; chaotic level: (20 - maligntyp) / (2 * ALIGNWEIGHT); unaligned: 0. ALIGNWEIGHT is 4, include/global.h:411

generation.temperature_shift: src/makemon.c:1641: +3 if the level is hot/cold and the monster resists that element. Only 3.7 / 5.0; no ordinary dungeon level sets it.
generation.special_pm: only mons[LOW_PM .. SPECIAL_PM-1] are considered; SPECIAL_PM is PM_LONG_WORM_TAIL, include/permonst.h

keys.a: attacks: [attack type, damage type, dice count, die size]
